mapper.select: SELECT * FROM courses WHERE package_id = #{packageId, typeHandler=com.flittly.bankendspringboot.config.UUIDTypeHandler} AND is_active = true ORDER BY order_index ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO courses (id, package_id, title, description, video_url, cover_url, duration, order_index, is_active, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id, typeHandler=com.flittly.bankendspringboot.config.UUIDTypeHandler}, #{packageId, typeHandler=com.flittly.bankendspringboot.config.UUIDTypeHandler}, #{title}, #{description}, #{videoUrl}, #{coverUrl}, #{duration}, #{orderIndex}, #{isActive}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM courses WHERE package_id = #{packageId, typeHandler=com.flittly.bankendspringboot.config.UUIDTypeHandler} AND is_active = true
